contraction_improving.description: constant loading reduction for 256 matched updates

defect_increasing.description: near-edge loading increase for 256 matched updates

sham.description: matched continuation with zero schedule dose

E0.estimand: Exact validation membership, full-matrix direct upper bounds, independent cover remainders, and strict cover utility margins.
E0.prediction: The construction-only physical domain certifies the direct row-map tube with positive utility margin.
E0.target: A physical row domain constructed only from its frozen construction partition, exact membership tests on disjoint validation rows, and an independent derivative-modulus times cell-radius remainder.
E0.title: Disjoint physical row domain and independent cover remainder
E0.unit_of_replication: seed by layer by checkpoint tube

E1.estimand: Full AdamW replay residual, lifted recurrence residual, defect recomposition residual, primitive enclosure ratios, applied learning rate, bias-corrected step, schedule increment, decay coefficient, and optimizer-state clock.
E1.prediction: Every accepted program cell maps into its registered successor with no caller-selected radius multiplier.
E1.target: The exact successor on parameters, both Adam moments, optimizer clock, scheduler phase, learning rate, row-cover state, and intervention state.
E1.title: Actual program-state successor and operation-ordered transport
E1.unit_of_replication: seed by tensor group by global optimizer step

E2.estimand: Registry completeness, right-inverse residual, closure-complement norm, frozen forcing, and validation residual envelopes through second order.
E2.prediction: The derivative-defined dense normal operator closes the complete stack with an explicit complement defect.
E2.target: The direct sum of every entry of every registered row-map Jacobian, together with a normal closure constructed from derivatives rather than a trajectory fit.
E2.title: Complete Jacobian stack and derivative-defined normal closure
E2.unit_of_replication: seed by layer by nominal checkpoint

E3.estimand: Lyapunov equation residual, metric lower edge, nominal gain, exact structured-family gain and slack, corner gain, multiaffine reconstruction, primitive-box membership, path-window gain, and observed H-gain.
E3.prediction: No stable scalar projection can hide an orthogonal or cross-layer expanding mode.
E3.target: A nonnegative comparison matrix derived from all diagonal and off-diagonal blocks of the lifted stack and program-state operator.
E3.title: Complete block comparison with every cross coupling
E3.unit_of_replication: seed by layer by primitive path cell

E4.estimand: Forcing, complete defect, complete disturbance, persistent source floor, d-infinity plus K r^n envelope ratio, transient rate, positive-comparison witness ratio, and recomposition residual.
E4.prediction: Primitive source bounds close without extrapolating a fitted disturbance trace.
E4.target: Source bounds derived from primitive intervals and derivatives, with explicit runtime error charges and no geometric trace fit.
E4.title: Primitive source ledger and runtime-to-exact bridge
E4.unit_of_replication: seed by layer by global optimizer step

E5.estimand: Initial membership, one-edge and closed-window lifted budgets, minimum path-prefix and auxiliary budgets, held-out image margin, escape count, and family-box enclosure ratio.
E5.prediction: The invariant tube is a consequence of the implemented successor, not a fitted tube around a trace.
E5.target: Forward invariance of the actual program and complete lifted stack under radii derived internally from interval images and derivatives.
E5.title: Derived successor-cell self-map
E5.unit_of_replication: seed by layer by direct certificate tube

E6.estimand: Predicted and observed entry step, identity error, complete persistent floor, registered path length and gain, block and schedule product-convolution bounds, criterion, direct upper bound, and sustained-entry indicator.
E6.prediction: The certificate yields the strongest collapse statement justified by the implemented future dynamics.
E6.target: A conclusion whose temporal scope is exactly one of a finite implemented schedule, an evaluation-only frozen checkpoint, or a controlled infinite tail.
E6.title: Finite, frozen, and controlled-tail collapse conclusions

E7.estimand: Within-seed contrasts in robust q, complete disturbance envelope, predicted horizon and direct upper bound, with lower and upper Jury margins, spectral loading, schedule product-convolution, and avalanche rate, size, and support retained as mechanism diagnostics. Held-out loss is a separate descriptive outcome.
E7.prediction: Schedule-controlled certificate changes move the horizon and Jacobian-burst observables in the predicted direction.
E7.target: Causal sensitivity of direct collapse to robust contraction and complete disturbance under registered anneal, near-edge pulse, and sham branches while the remaining certificate clauses are held.
E7.title: Paired schedule and certificate interventions

E8.estimand: Theorem-bound ratio, sufficient-horizon coverage, direct entry relative to the physical criterion, order-parameter bridge ratio, paired model-score error against frozen baselines, and the exact density, LayerNorm, softmax, and blocking-semigroup residuals, deductive and conditional full-layer closure ratios, and descriptive avalanche scaling observables.
E8.prediction: The direct certificate transfers, bounds the inference order parameter, closes under deductive-sector blocking, and outpredicts frozen baselines.
E8.target: Out-of-sample specificity of the complete direct bound and finite horizon, plus the direct-to-inference order-parameter bridge, and deductive-sector renormalization closure across unseen schedule, width, depth, and token-block cells.
E8.title: Held-out scale transfer, observable bridge, and RG closure
